cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Over dinner you keep saying you're managing. What's hard about going home? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The silence. I leave the television on so it sounds occupied.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could you ask me over instead of pretending you've got company?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cook. I promise I won't be miserable all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you invite me without that promise? I'd like to come even if you're miserable and we eat toast.

mechanism: A plans the evening but adjusts visiting terms so B can ask for company without promising an upbeat performance.
confusable: Unlike simply providing help, A requires an invitation without a strength condition; authority softens the proposed arrangement to retain consent.
comparison: A friend facing a silent home differs from a shop boss performing morale for an employee.
seedUse: D108-b television company and promised good mood; S02-a changes the plan to obtain cooperation rather than naming control.
